memories.summary: House invaded at night. Male partner killed and burned. Taken captive by the goblin.
Months of restraint, sexual use, edging, care, and isolation. Resistance hollowed into passive acceptance. Automatic arousal responses to the goblin.
Teaching basic common tongue over weeks. Conversations remain simple and practical.
Revealed her name as Elena when asked.
Cooks, maintains house tasks, follows on walks, accepts sexual contact without active refusal. Residual shame present but dulled. No escape attempts. Slim build, dark brown hair, D-cup breasts.
